name: Big counter
what: One big number counts up and lands with a kick, a label above and a caption under it - over a glow rising from the bottom, an area chart drawing behind it with a tag on its tip, or on a white card.

learned_from.what: the big green percentage over a rising glow, the two-line caption
the count with an area chart rising behind it and a tag on the curve (~49 f at 25 fps)
the number counting on a white card

motion: in 10 f, counts 45 f (power3.out) growing to 1.06, lands with a back.out kick; the glow rises with it and breathes
